tests.name: Fifth hero has seven distinct forms, twenty-one named skills and its catalyst weapon
Transformation changes appearance and skills while retaining cooldowns, health and ultimate charge
Every form Q damages a target using its actual attack behavior
Every form E implements a persistent field or actual earth shield
Every ultimate damages and never refills itself, including delayed hits and fields
Split modes create exactly 3, 5 or 7 different living elemental bodies
Clone AI really attacks and does not generate free ultimate charge
Changing the leader form during a split preserves remaining time and unique elements
Recall retains cooldown, expired clones disappear and paused games do not run timers
Hostile bullets hit and remove clones without damaging the leader remotely
Zero damage cannot grant a clone protection from real damage
Ice actually slows and freezes movement, nature poison deals damage, light reflects without ult charge
Shots keep their original element after transformation
Combined ultimate contains all seven elements, real damage and no self charging
Save and restore retain form, split size, remaining time, clone health and player resources
Malformed clone saves are bounded and old heroes keep their progress
Death and travel cancel clones and scheduled attacks
New source parses and art is a deployable transparent PNG
